review_notes: Read the whole target file and its downstream users (BranchInterfaces.lean, ExistenceFromLocalGeometry.lean references). The file has no @[simp] attributes. The only simp-interface issue I found is that the new def `components` is built on Fin.cases and has no equation lemmas for index 0 and `Fin.succ`; every proof about it unfolds Fin.cases by hand (here and in BranchInterfaces.lean). Other simp calls (`simpa using hij`, `simp only [ae_add_measure_iff]`, `simpa only [dist_comm]`) look fine; I saw no loop or competing-rule risk. I did not run Lean, so the proposed lemmas are untested; they should hold by rfl because Fin.cases reduces on 0 and succ.

findings.excerpt:
def components (K : Set E3) (H : Fin 4 → E3 → E3) : Fin 5 → Set E3 :=
  Fin.cases K (fun i => H i '' K)
findings.problem: `components` is a Fin.cases-defined family with no simp/equation lemmas for its two constructors (index 0 and `Fin.succ i`). Every proof that touches it must unfold Fin.cases by hand, e.g. `exact Fin.cases hK (fun j => hK.image_of_continuousOn (hH j)) i` in compact_components, and `Fin.cases hKB (fun j => image_mono hKB) i` in disjoint_components_mono. The downstream file BranchInterfaces.lean repeats the pattern with `refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i` four times. Members such as `components K H i.succ` are also used implicitly in `mem_image_of_mem _ hx` and `hsep 0 i.succ …`, which only typecheck by defeq. `simp` has no canonical normal form for `components K H 0` or `components K H i.succ`.
findings.proposed_change:
Add the canonical reduction lemmas right after the def and mark them simp:
`@[simp] lemma components_zero (K : Set E3) (H : Fin 4 → E3 → E3) : components K H 0 = K := rfl`
`@[simp] lemma components_succ (K : Set E3) (H : Fin 4 → E3 → E3) (i : Fin 4) : components K H i.succ = H i '' K := rfl`
They are oriented toward the unfolded sets, and the right-hand sides do not mention `components`, so they cannot loop. Then the Fin.cases proofs can be written as `Fin.cases (by simpa using hK) (fun j => by simpa using …)`, or `refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> simp`. The case analyses in BranchInterfaces.pairwise_components_of_disjoint_branches can also use the lemmas instead of relying on defeq.
findings.benefit: Readers and downstream proofs get a stable simp normal form (`K` and `H i '' K`) for the transported-component family. Case splits over Fin 5 no longer depend on defeq unfolding of Fin.cases, and the duplicated manual Fin.cases boilerplate in this file and in BranchInterfaces.lean shrinks.
